# 3.
```{r}
ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",     # fuse IN  → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",     # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)

training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

full_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]
training_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]

# Merge on full identity
index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels: 1 = pos, 2 = strong neg -> make 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", nrow(data)))
cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(data$label == 1L)))
cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n\n", sum(data$label == 0L)))

# Predictors
predictors <- scan(predictor_file, what = character(), quiet = TRUE)
feature_cols  <- intersect(predictors, names(data))

celltypes <- sort(unique(data$celltype))
```

# Functions
```{r}
tune_xgb <- function(X, y, chr, heldout_ct, outfile = ".") {
  df <- data.frame(X)
  df$label <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1))
  df$chr   <- chr
  
  task <- TaskClassif$new(
    id       = paste0("xgb_tuning_", heldout_ct),
    backend  = df,
    target   = "label",
    positive = "1"
  )
  task$set_col_roles("chr", add_to = "group", remove_from = "feature")
  
  learner <- mlr3::lrn("classif.xgboost",
    booster     = "gbtree",
    objective   = "binary:logistic",
    nrounds     = 120,
    eval_metric = "aucpr",
    predict_type = "prob"
  )
  learner$param_set$values$nthread <- 16
  
  learner$param_set$values$gamma            <- generic_params$gamma
  learner$param_set$values$min_child_weight <- generic_params$min_child_weight
  learner$param_set$values$subsample        <- generic_params$subsample
  learner$param_set$values$colsample_bytree <- generic_params$colsample_bytree

  paramSet <- ParamSet$new(list(
    eta               = p_dbl(lower = 0.01,  upper = 0.3),
    max_depth         = p_int(lower = 3,     upper = 10),
    #gamma             = p_dbl(lower = 0,     upper = 20),
    #min_child_weight  = p_int(lower = 1,     upper = 20),
    #subsample         = p_dbl(lower = 0.5,   upper = 1.0),
    #colsample_bytree  = p_dbl(lower = 0.5,   upper = 1.0),
    lambda            = p_dbl(lower = 0,     upper = 1000),
    alpha             = p_dbl(lower = 0,     upper = 1000)
  ))
  
  measure <- msr("classif.logloss")

  terminator <- mlr3tuning::trm("combo",
                              list(mlr3tuning::trm("stagnation", iters=10, threshold=0.001),
                                   mlr3tuning::trm("evals", n_evals=500)), any=FALSE)
  rs <- rsmp("loo")
  rs$instantiate(task)
  

  inst <- mlr3tuning::ti(task=task,
                           learner=learner,
                           resampling=rs,
                           measure=measure,
                           search_space=paramSet,
                           terminator=terminator)
  tuner <- TunerMbo$new()
  tuner$optimize(inst)
  
  saveRDS(inst, file.path(outfile, paste0("tuning_instance_", heldout_ct, ".rds")))
  
  return(inst$result_learner_param_vals)
}

train_xgb <- function(X, y, params, folds, max_nrounds = 500) {
  # remove problematic keys from tuned params
  params$nrounds    <- NULL
  params$nthread    <- NULL
  params$objective  <- NULL
  params$eval_metric <- NULL
  
  # set the ones you actually want
  params$objective   <- "binary:logistic"
  params$eval_metric <- "aucpr"
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(X), label = y)
  
  # CV to find best nrounds
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    data = dtrain,
    params = params,
    nrounds = max_nrounds,
    folds = folds,
    nthread = 8,
    early_stopping_rounds = 10,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
  
  # Final training
  bst <- xgb.train(
    params  = params,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds,
    nthread = 8,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  return(list(model = bst, best_nrounds = best_nrounds))
}

predict_and_score <- function(model_obj, X_test, y_test) {
  bst <- if (is.list(model_obj)) model_obj$model else model_obj
  p_hat <- predict(bst, as.matrix(X_test))
  
  logloss <- -mean(y_test*log(p_hat + 1e-15) + (1-y_test)*log(1 - p_hat + 1e-15))
  
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_test==1],
                        scores.class1 = p_hat[y_test==0],
                        curve = FALSE)
  
  return(list(
    preds = data.table(prob = p_hat, label = y_test),
    metrics = list(logloss = logloss, auprc = pr$auc.integral)
  ))
}



```

```{r}
results <- list()

for (ct in celltypes) {
  message("Held-out cell type: ", ct)
  
  # --- Split ---
  train_idx <- data$celltype != ct
  test_idx  <- data$celltype == ct
  
  X_train <- data[train_idx, ..feature_cols]
  y_train <- data$label[train_idx]
  chr_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
  
  X_test <- data[test_idx, ..feature_cols]
  y_test <- data$label[test_idx]
  
  # --- Tuning ---
  tuned_params <- tune_xgb(
    X_train, y_train, chr_train,
    heldout_ct = ct, outfile = outfile
  )
  
  # --- Training ---
  # chromosome folds
  chrs_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
  folds <- split(seq_along(chrs_train), chrs_train)
  
  message("training generic model")
  generic_model <- train_xgb(X_train, y_train, generic_params, folds = folds, max_nrounds = 500)
  
  message("training tuned model")
  tuned_model   <- train_xgb(X_train, y_train, tuned_params,   folds = folds, max_nrounds = 500)
  
  xgb.save(generic_model$model,
         fname = file.path(model_dir, paste0("xgb_generic_", ct, ".model")))

  xgb.save(tuned_model$model,
           fname = file.path(model_dir, paste0("xgb_tuned_", ct, ".model")))

  # --- Predict + score ---
  res_generic <- predict_and_score(generic_model, X_test, y_test)
  res_tuned   <- predict_and_score(tuned_model,   X_test, y_test)
  
  # --- Save predictions ---
  # Add metadata columns: heldout cell type, model type
  preds_generic <- cbind(celltype = ct, model = "generic", res_generic$preds)
  preds_tuned   <- cbind(celltype = ct, model = "tuned",   res_tuned$preds)
  
  data.table::fwrite(
    preds_generic,
    file = file.path(pred_dir, paste0("predictions_generic_", ct, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  data.table::fwrite(
    preds_tuned,
    file = file.path(pred_dir, paste0("predictions_tuned_", ct, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # --- Collect summary metrics ---
  results[[ct]] <- list(
    tuned_params = tuned_params,
    generic = res_generic$metrics,
    tuned   = res_tuned$metrics
  )
}

# Save all summary metrics
saveRDS(results, file = file.path(pred_dir, "summary_metrics.rds"))
```

```{r}
# read all predictions back in
pred_files <- list.files(pred_dir, pattern = "^predictions_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
all_preds  <- rbindlist(lapply(pred_files, fread))

prDt <- TFBlearner:::.getPRCurve(all_preds, scores="prob", labels="label", models=c("model", "celltype"), posClass =1, negClass = 0, aggregate=TRUE)
ggplot(prDt, aes(x=celltype, color=model, y=auc_pr_mod))+geom_point()

# check structure
head(all_preds)

compute_pr <- function(df) {
  stopifnot(all(c("prob", "label") %in% names(df)))
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = df$prob[df$label == 1],
                 scores.class1 = df$prob[df$label == 0],
                 curve = TRUE)
  data.table(recall = pr$curve[,1],
             precision = pr$curve[,2],
             model = unique(df$model),
             aucpr = pr$auc.integral)
}

pr_curves <- rbindlist(lapply(split(all_preds, all_preds$model), compute_pr))

ggplot(pr_curves, aes(x = recall, y = precision, color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(x = "Recall", y = "Precision",
       title = "PR Curves: Generic vs Tuned",
       subtitle = sprintf("AUPRC generic=%.3f, tuned=%.3f",
                          unique(pr_curves[model=="generic"]$aucpr),
                          unique(pr_curves[model=="tuned"]$aucpr))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
tuningInstances <- list.files(outfile, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "tuning_instance_.*\\.rds$")
archives <- lapply(tuningInstances, function(f) {
  inst <- readRDS(f)
  arch <- as.data.table(inst$archive$data)
  arch[, iter := seq_len(.N)]
  arch[, celltype := sub("tuning_instance_(.*)\\.rds", "\\1", basename(f))]
  
  # mark best row
  best_iter <- arch[which.min(classif.logloss), iter]
  arch[, best_iter := best_iter]
  return(arch)
})

all_arch <- rbindlist(archives)

# Plot
ggplot(all_arch, aes(x = iter, y = classif.logloss, color = celltype)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1.2, span = 0.3) +  # smooth curve per CT
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = best_iter, color = celltype),
             data = unique(all_arch[, .(celltype, best_iter)]),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +      # vertical line at min
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Iteration", y = "Logloss (log scale)",
       title = "Tuning trajectories across cell types",
       subtitle = "Smoothed curves; dashed line = iteration of minimum logloss") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
tuningInstances <- list.files(outfile, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "tuning_instance_.*\\.rds$")

archives <- lapply(tuningInstances, function(f) {
  inst <- readRDS(f)
  arch <- as.data.table(inst$archive$best())
  arch[, celltype := sub("tuning_instance_(.*)\\.rds", "\\1", basename(f))]
  return(arch)
})

all_archives <- rbindlist(archives)
all_archives


plot_dt <- melt(
  all_archives,
  id.vars = "celltype",
  #measure.vars = c("eta","max_depth","lambda","alpha"),
  measure.vars = c("eta","max_depth","lambda","alpha", "min_child_weight", "subsample", "colsample_bytree", "gamma"),
  variable.name = "parameter",
  value.name = "value"
)

ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = celltype, y = value, color = parameter)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Cell type", y = "Parameter value",
       title = "Best tuned XGBoost parameters per cell type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
